calendar_date_robustness.weighting: Remaining arrival types within group, surviving groups within dataset, two main datasets equally; missing dataset fails.

mbpp_sentinel.gating: Gates overall advance only; cannot alter or rescue main inference or its hierarchy

confirmatory.main_claim: Useful high-load mean-response gain versus stockoff and current on the two main datasets, conditional on main safeguards

bootstrap.unit: Whole main content bundle: both arrival types, loads and all arms
bootstrap.draw_indices_encoding: Concatenate complete [samples,8] tables in GSM8K,WildChat order; little-endian signed int64 C-order; no header
bootstrap.scope: Conditional on selected trace material, content construction, fixed payload mix and one allocation; excludes MBPP and new-day/deployment variation

confirmatory.hierarchy: Main stockoff primary,10guards and main date checks gate current secondary. MBPPpoint sentinel additionally gates overall advance; never main inferential intervals.

scope: Main inference on two datasets conditional on selected trace/content and one allocation; MBPP is a separate descriptive operational sentinel.
limitations: Current/fix physical assignment identity is audited separately; no offline routing enters final arms.
Controller tails are post-output extent, not exclusive cost; complete elapsed includes horizon/drain.
Numerics:4,112whole batches/group against stockoff;64FP32 positions/group;16whole postflight batches/trial plus resident-weight checks.
Independent bank/route/lifecycle and statistical audits remain required.
